key_positions: Peak carbon emissions before 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality by 2060
Massively scale renewable energy — already world leader in solar and wind installation
Demand developed nations honor $100 billion per year climate finance pledge
Differentiate responsibilities: developed nations must act first as historical emitters
Pursue green development without sacrificing economic growth and poverty alleviation
Lead South-South cooperation on green technology transfer
red_lines: Reject any external interference in China's sovereign development timeline
Oppose carbon tariffs (like CBAM) as disguised trade protectionism
Will not accept binding targets that constrain the right to development
Developed nations must provide technology transfer and finance, not just demands
stance_summary: China argues for common but differentiated responsibilities, asserting that developed nations caused historical emissions and must lead financially and technologically while allowing developing economies to grow sustainably on their own timelines.
